summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders, held on May 6, 2026. The filing discloses routine matters: election of 12 directors, re-appointment of KPMG as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation, all approved by substantial majorities. There are no special-situation elements such as merger proposals, tender offers, activist demands, or strategic changes. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07. The content is purely administrative with no transaction or corporate action meeting special-situation criteria.
